comment: Facial action units (FACS) as regions of the face that move, and expressions that mix them. Sizes and moves are in mouth widths; directions in the face's own frame: up (mouth to eyes), front (out of the face, towards the nose tip), out (away from the face's middle). Regions sit at the face points placed as joints: mouth (mouth_l, mouth_r: the corners), eye (eye_l, eye_r: the lower lids), cheek (cheek_l, cheek_r: the cheekbones), nose (its tip); derived: fold (nasolabial fold, between a mouth corner and the nose wing), lips (the middle of the mouth). A region with a side moves only the points above (upper) or below (lower) the mouth slit. teeth: the arch of teeth and the mouth cavity behind the lips, shown when the lips part.
